shots.prompt: One continuous medium-wide fixed-camera shot. The input image is the exact final frame of the previous video. Begin from that exact pose, object state, subject orientation, framing, lighting, and camera position. Continue forward in time immediately; do not replay, reset, or summarize any previous action. Natural subject orientation: preserve the exact coherent object orientation in the input frame. Every object keeps one coherent shape, orientation, count, and contact with the scene unless the requested action visibly changes it. Actions in exact order: The waves continue their forward motion toward the shore at a consistent speed and direction, maintaining their current form as they advance, then the waves gradually lose their energy and height, becoming smoother and calmer as they reach the shallower water near the sand. End state: The waves have flattened out significantly, appearing much calmer and less turbulent than in the previous state, with minimal movement remaining. No cut, transition, reset, sudden zoom, duplicate object, or unrelated action.
